title: Meat substitutes containing animal myoglobin
abstract: Meat substitutes or food ingredients comprising animal myoglobin protein, genetic constructs comprising nucleic acids encoding said protein, host cells comprising said genetic constructs, and methods for producing said myoglobin or said meat substitutes are described herein.

title: EMULSIFYING COMPOSITION COMPRISING BREWER'S SPENT GRAINS AND METHOD OF PREPARING AND USE OF THE EMULSIFYING COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention relates to an emulsifying composition, wherein the composition comprises milled brewer's spent grains having a volume-weighted mean particle size of 160 µm or less, and preferably a particle size distribution with a 10% cumulative particle size (d10) of 10 µm or less and a 90% cumulative particle size (d90) of between 120 µm and 275 µm, and a protein content of between 15-30 wt.% with respect to the total weight of the brewer's spent grains. The present invention further relates to the use of the emulsifying composition of the present invention in the preparation of food products. Further, the present invention also relates to a method of preparing an emulsifying composition comprising milled brewer's spent grains, the method comprising the successive steps of: a) providing brewer's spent grains, b) milling the brewer's spent grains provided in step a), and c) optionally, sieving the milled brewer's spent grains.

title: METHODS AND COMPOSITION FOR PALATABLE PET FOODS
abstract: Pet food compositions and methods of making such pet food compositions are disclosed including utilizing a palatant selected from the group consisting of dimethyl sulphide, isoamyl alcohol, 2-methyloxolan-3-one, 2,5-dimethylpyrazine, 2-ethyl-3,5-dimethylpyrazine, furfural, furfuryl alcohol, and combinations thereof, wherein the composition has at least one combination of compounds as provided in Table 10 in ratios as provided in Table 10.

title: Edible food and its manufacturing method
abstract: The present invention relates to a method (100) for producing an edible food product, said method (100) using a protein matrix and a fat matrix, said method (100) comprising the steps of: processing (140) the protein matrix using a threading device (10) to form one or more edible protein threads (220); guiding the one or more edible protein threads (220) onto a collecting device (30) using a guiding device (50); and adding the fat matrix to the one or more edible protein threads (220) using a dispensing device (60) such that the fat matrix is located within the edible protein thread assembly (280). The present invention also relates to a system (1) for producing an edible food product and an edible food product obtained by the method (100) according to the present invention.

title: METHOD OF PRODUCING A LOW-FAT PRODUCT AND A SYSTEM FOR PRODUCING A LOW-FAT PRODUCT
abstract: A method of producing a low-fat product from a starting material made of a fat and/or oil containing plant- or animal item includes providing the starting material at a temperature of at least 35° C. and extracting a greater part of the extractable oil and/or fat originally contained in the plant or animal item from the starting material using a first decanter centrifuge. The first decanter centrifuge is thereby leaving a residue of solids and liquids. The residue is forming the low-fat product.

title: Food Products Comprising Avian Stem Cells
abstract: A synthetic meat product for human and animal consumption and methods for producing such food product are disclosed. The synthetic food product comprises or essentially consists of a cell biomass of avian cells grown in vitro in a chemically-defined serum free culture medium under controlled conditions and do not contain any hazard contaminations.

title: FERMENTED ROASTED CAROB
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for the preparation of a fermented roasted carob, in particular a fermented roasted carob powder which can be used as base ingredient characterized by a color, sensory profile, and volatile compounds similar to cocoa powder. Furthermore, the present invention relates to a fermented roasted carob obtained by the method of the invention. Moreover, the present invention relates to the use of the fermented roasted carob for replacing up to 100% of roasted cocoa and in products based on or containing cocoa and in various forms (powder, liquid, solid).

title: Soybean line EC2020188
abstract: The present invention is directed in part to soybean variety EC2020188 breeding and development. The present invention particularly relates to soybean variety EC2020188 and its seed, cells, germplasm, plant parts, and progeny, and methods of using EC2020188, e.g., in a breeding program.

title: Microbial extract, use and application
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of producing a microbial cell extract with improved functional properties. The invention further relates to a microbial cell extract obtainable or obtained by said method. The invention further relates to the use of said microbial cell extract with improved functionality for gelling agents, thickeners, foaming agents, emulsifiers, texturizing agents and other suitable applications.

title: MODIFIED STRAINS OF CHLORELLA VULGARIS AND METHOD OF PRODUCTION
abstract: Disclosed are modified strains of Chlorella vulgaris having a very low chlorophyll content. Also disclosed is a method for producing them. The method involves performing mutagenesis of a parental strain of Chlorella vulgaris. Furthermore, disclosed is a composition comprising algae biomass derived from the modified strains of Chlorella vulgaris and their use in food and/or cosmetics amongst other applications.

title: CLEANING DEVICE FOR CLEANING A SYSTEM COMPONENT, CLEANING SYSTEM, ARRANGEMENT AND CONVEYOR SYSTEM
abstract: Cleaning apparatus for cleaning an installation component of a conveyor system for conveying bulk material, comprising: at least one cleaning tool for cleaning at least a part of the installation component, and a carrier section for fastening the cleaning apparatus to the installation component, to a transport device, and/or to an external object, wherein the cleaning apparatus is designed to independently initiate a cleaning process for cleaning at least a part of the installation component, and a cleaning system including such a cleaning apparatus, and a service station, an assembly comprising the cleaning apparatus, and the installation component and a conveyor system.

title: Nanofiber scaffolds for industrial-scale cell culture
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for preparing a nanofibrous scaffold and its use for facilitating cell culture. In particular, the nanofibrous scaffold comprises cross-linked cellulose nanofibers that result in a continuous microcarrier material for use in industrial-scale cell culture devices. title: Pet food and how to prepare pet food
abstract: The application relates to animal feed and a method for its production, wherein the raw material comprises meat and animal products in the range of 50% to 80% by weight; fish and fish products in the range of 4% to 36% by weight; molluscs and crustaceans in the range of 0% to 14% by weight; poultry eggs in the range of 3% to 7% by weight; starch in the range of 3% to 7% by weight; vegetables and/or fruits in the range of 0% to 10% by weight; glycerine of plant origin in the range of 0% to 8% by weight; mineral additives in the range of 0% to 2% by weight; oils in the range of 0.1% to 2% by weight; powdered cellulose in the range of 0.1% to 2% by weight; functional additives in the range of 0.01% to 0.8% of parts by weight; vitamin and mineral mixture in the range of 0.1% to 0.2% of parts by weight; herbs in the range of 0.01% to 0.05% of parts by weight; fat for coating, preferably with the addition of a natural antioxidant, preferably beef or chicken in the range of 1% to 6% of parts by weight.

title: Cell culture system and method
abstract: The present invention relates to methods and devices for culturing cells. Methods and apparatus for providing seed culture, including chemostats, turbidimeters, or chemostats, and methods and apparatus for media replacement during culture using gravity settling separation are provided.
